f.t: Their 2015 debut album as Du Blonde, Welcome Back To Milk, was recorded in London and Los Angeles with producer Jim Sclavunos.

f.t: Lung Bread for Daddy, their 2019 album as Du Blonde, was the first they produced themselves.
f.q: Du Blonde's second album, Lung Bread for Daddy, was released on 22 February 2019 via Moshi Moshi. The album is the first to be produced by Houghton
